objective_2.task: observable temporal posture-state recognition, not medical risk prediction
objective_2.source: Charades official training videos and temporal action intervals
objective_2.evaluation: subject-grouped out-of-fold predictions within the official train split
objective_2.unsupported_claim: prolonged-sitting risk; Charades clips average about 30 seconds and contain no long-duration health outcome label

objective_3.task: human-environment relation recognition under unseen residential scenes and unseen subjects
objective_3.source: Charades official training split and official RGB fc7 features
objective_3.evaluation: leave each of the five largest scenes out; remove all held-out subjects from training
